subject: WellNova - Compliance add-ons: pricing concession & evidence delivery
messages:
From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@wellnova.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procure@wellnova.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Compliance add-ons pricing - evidence timing and concession request

Diego / Laura,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — team liked the latency profiles. Before we move to an internal exec review, procurement asked me to get clarity on two things so we can size the ask: audit-log retention to 7 years for a subset of tables, an HSM-backed KMS option for key escrow, and EU residency for patient PII replication.

Specifically:
- Can Redwood provide a one-time implementation credit to cover evidence collection and SOC mapping, or does that cost get amortized into the monthly add-on?
- What would an early-stage concession look like (pilot to 100k requests/mo): is there room for a temporary discount on audit-log ingest for the first 12 months?
- We need an evidence-delivery timeline we can circulate to our security and legal teams (they'll want milestones for artifacts: SOC, attestation, KMS configuration proof, and sample audit logs).

We are targeting a procurement packet by 4/20. Any chance you can share an itemized example and a proposed concession we can show the CFO?

Attachments: list of our compliance matrix (not attached here)

Thanks,
Elena Torres
Senior Security Program Manager
WellNova Labs

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@wellnova.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Compliance add-ons pricing - evidence timing and concession request

Elena — great to hear the demo landed well. Short answer: yes, we can structure a pilot concession and a one-time implementation credit. Longer answer with options below. I attached a short pricing_breakdown.pdf and an evidence delivery spreadsheet to illustrate milestones.

Option A (Pilot concession + one-time credit):
- One-time Evidence Implementation Credit: USD 45,000 (covers SOC mapping, attestations, scripted evidence extracts). Applied as an upfront credit that offsets the onboarding invoice.
- Audit-log ingest concession: 50% off ingest fees for first 12 months on the pilot namespace (up to 100k reqs/mo). After 12 months, normal rates apply unless agreed otherwise.
- HSM/KMS: charged as a recurring seat (or throughput slab) — we can give 25% discount on the first year for committed pilots.
- Residency: EU replication scoped as per-hosting region; minimal setup fee plus recurring regional egress.

Option B (Amortized model):
- No upfront credit; implement the evidence work and amortize USD 60,000 across 12 months as a monthly surcharge. No temporary ingest concession.

Recommended path for WellNova (to get procurement sign-off quickly): Option A — keeps numbers clean in the procurement packet and shows explicit pilot economics.

Deliverables & timeline (draft):
1) Week 1-2: SOW + redline (we'll circulate redline_SOW_v2.docx)
2) Week 3: Evidence collection runbook + initial attestations
3) Week 4-6: KMS/HSM configuration evidence + sample audit log extracts (we'll deliver CSV samples and a short replay script)

Next steps:
- If that aligns, I'll send you a redlined SOW and a formal concession letter for CFO review. If procurement needs PO language, have them send over the template and we can map line items.

Attachments: pricing_breakdown.pdf, evidence_delivery_schedule.xlsx

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Enterprise Sales (Security & Compliance)
Redwood Inference

>
> Thanks for the demo yesterday — team liked the latency profiles. Before we move to an internal exec review, procurement asked me to get clarity on two things so we can size the ask: audit-log retention to 7 years for a subset of tables, an HSM-backed KMS option for key escrow, and EU residency for patient PII replication.
>

Thanks for the quick reply, Diego. A couple of practical asks from procurement that will speed approval:
- Can you provide an itemized quote with separate line items for: Audit-log retention (monthly), Audit-log ingest (per GB/req), KMS/HSM (monthly seat or slab), Evidence implementation fee (one-time), EU replication (monthly).
- Please split the Evidence Implementation Credit and make clear how it appears on the invoice (line credit vs. zeroed-out line item).
- We need a draft SOW with milestones and acceptance criteria; if you can deliver a redline within 48 hours we can attach to our packet.

Also, confirm whether the 50% pilot concession applies to third-party storage charges (we assume no).

Procurement will expect a PO template to map to invoice codes — if Redwood can populate a sample PO line mapping that's ideal.

Procurement
WellNova Labs
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2027 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Compliance add-ons pricing - evidence timing and concession request

Laura / Ben — forwarding WellNova thread. Key asks: itemized quote, SOW redline, and confirmation that pilot concession does not cover third-party storage. Attachments are the pricing_breakdown.pdf and evidence_delivery_schedule.xlsx.

Question for you both before I return to Elena and procurement:
1) Margin check: If we offer the one-time USD 45k evidence credit + 50% audit ingest concession for 12 months, what net margin do we expect on the pilot? (Ben, can you run on the attached pricing_breakdown and confirm).
2) Contract approach: Do we want to present the credit as an upfront invoice credit (preferred by procurement) or as a waived invoice line? Redlined SOW is attached (redline_SOW_v2.docx) — Laura, if you can sign off on milestones/acceptance language I can push the redline within 24h.
3) Approval authority: At what customer ARR / discount threshold do we need manager approval to lock the concession? I think 15% extra concession would require AM lead sign-off.

I propose we lock Option A with the one-time credit but hold the 25% HSM first-year discount until we get final ARR commit. If we're aligned I'll send the formal concession letter and a populated sample PO mapping back to procurement.

Thanks — Diego
